# The simplest way to create formshighlight
Say goodbye to boring forms. Meet Tally — the free, intuitive form builder you’ve been looking for.

Create a free form

No signup required

![floating faces with different expressions](/images/demo/v2/faces-left.png)

[](/videos/demo/intro.mp4#t=15)

Powering 500,000+ teams at the world’s best companies

![Notion logo](/images/demo/v2/logos/notion.png)

![Make logo](/images/demo/v2/logos/make.png)

![Buy Me a Coffee logo](/images/demo/v2/logos/buy-me-a-coffee.png)

![Rakuten logo](/images/demo/v2/logos/rakuten.png)

![Glovo logo](/images/demo/v2/logos/glovo.png)

[![Tally 2.0 - The simplest way to create forms for free | Product Hunt](https://api.producthunt.com/widgets/embed-image/v1/golden-kitty-badge.svg?post_id=415284&theme=dark)](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/tally-2-0?utm_source=badge-golden-kitty-badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_souce=badge-tally-2-0)

## A form builder like no other
Tally makes it simple for anyone to build free online forms. No need to code — just type your questions like you would in a doc.

![Person jumping in](/images/demo/v2/dust.png)

### Unlimited forms and submissions for free
Paywalls getting in the way? Not anymore. Tally gives you unlimited forms and submissions, completely free, as long as you stay within our [fair usage guidelines](/help/fair-use-policy).

![Unlimited forms and submissions for free](/images/demo/v2/dive-in.png)

### Just start typing
Tally is a new type of online form builder that works like a text document. Just start typing on the page and insert blocks same as Notion.

[](/videos/demo/just-type-card.mp4)

### Privacy-friendly form builder
Your data privacy and security are our top priorities. We are **GDPR compliant** and treat your data with care and confidentiality.

Tally is **hosted in Europe**, we don’t use cookie-tracking, and all form data is securely stored, and **encrypted** both in transit and at rest. [Learn more about Tally & GDPR](/help/gdpr).

![Encrypted form data](/images/demo/v2/encryption.png)

“Loving Tally! Not sure why I only started using it now, so good!”

![Ben Lang](/images/demo/v2/quote-ben.jpg)

Ben Lang

Angel investor, previously at Notion

## Simple buthighlight powerful
Advanced features packed in a simple form builder. It couldn’t be easier to create forms that convert.

![Person clicking on a plus sign](/images/demo/v2/click-plus.png)

### Build any form in seconds
Easily create online forms using our wide range of free input blocks. Collect contact info, files, signatures, payments, and much more. Build everything from surveys to quizzes to lead generation forms.

![Various input badges](/images/demo/v2/input-badges.png)

Contact info. Collect names, addresses, phone numbers, emails & links.

Accept payments. Create checkout forms without code.

Signatures. Accept e-signatures and streamline contract signing.

Rate & rank. Let users share their opinions using visually simple ratings, scales, and rankings.

File uploads. Collect images, PDFs, video and audio files.

Date & Time. Allow respondents easily select date and time.

## Craft intelligenthighlight forms
Our smart features make it easy to turn your forms into a tailored experience for every respondent.

![Craft intelligent forms](/images/demo/v2/smart.png)

### Conditional logic
Build dynamic forms that adapt based on prior inputs or external data. Show and hide blocks, insert branching, or calculate values to create a personalized form experience.

![Conditional logic](/images/demo/v2/smart-3.png)

### Calculator
Use variables to create dynamic content and calculate values, scores, prices and more.

![Calculator](/images/demo/v2/smart-2.png)

### Hidden fields
Pass data to your form with URL parameters. Include UTM parameters or personal data for a customized experience.

tally.so/r/3qDpEY?*name=Lucy*

![Hidden fields](/images/demo/v2/smart-1.png)

Answer piping. Mention answers from earlier questions to personalize your form.

Email notifications. Send tailored emails to yourself and respondents.

Redirect on completion. Forward respondents to another web page.

Pre-populate fields. Save time by pre-filling form fields with data you already have about respondents.

reCAPTCHA. Protect your forms from spam and bots.

Partial submissions. Capture unfinished form submissions.

“Tally is doing to forms what Notion did to docs & sheets.”

![Nathan Castiel](/images/demo/v2/quote-nathan.png)

Natan Castiel

Head of Growth, Gelt

## Make forms uniquely yourshighlight
Easily customize the design and layout to fit any form to your brand.

![Customize your form](/images/demo/v2/customize.png)

### Customize your form
Use our pre-made themes or create your own design by customizing colors, fonts, buttons, and more.

Column layout. Display content side-by-side using columns.

Custom CSS. Inject custom CSS to fully control your form design.

Images. Add a logo, cover image and embed visuals.

Embed online content. Embed YouTube, Calendly, Maps, and more.

Multi-page forms. Create a single-page or multi-page form.

50+ supported languages. Translate the default form messages for respondents worldwide.

## highlightShare with your audience
Tailor how you share and display forms to connect with your audience across platforms.

![Share with your audience](/images/demo/v2/paper-plane.png)

### Embed
Seamlessly embed your forms into your website, landing page, or Notion. Whether you use WordPress, Webflow, Framer, or any other website builder, integrating Tally forms into your web pages is simple.

![Pink arrow](/images/demo/v2/pink-arrow.png)

### Popup
Create an eye-catching popup form for your website in seconds.

Click me

### Tally links
Share your unique Tally form link with anyone.

tally.so/r/3qDpEY

Open in new tab

### Custom domains
Host forms on your own (sub)domain to create branded form links.

forms.yourdomain.com/feedback

## highlightConnect your favorite tools
Save time using popular integrations to sync your form submissions.

![Connect your favorite tools](/images/demo/v2/strategy.png)

![Notion integration](/images/integrations/icon_NOTION.png)[Notion](/help/notion-integration). Send submissions to Notion.

![Google Sheets integration](/images/integrations/icon_GOOGLE_SHEETS.png)[Google Sheets](/help/google-sheets-integration). Send submissions to a sheet.

![Airtable integration](/images/integrations/icon_AIRTABLE.png)[Airtable](/help/airtable-integration). Send submissions to Airtable.

![Webhooks integration](/images/integrations/icon_WEBHOOKS.png)[Webhooks](/help/webhooks). Send events for new submissions to HTTP endpoints.

![Slack integration](/images/integrations/icon_SLACK.png)[Slack](/help/slack-integration). Send Slack messages for new submissions.

![Coda integration](/images/integrations/icon_CODA.png)[Coda](/help/coda-integration). Send submissions to Coda.

![Google Analytics integration](/images/integrations/icon_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS.png)[Google Analytics](/help/google-analytics-integration). Analyze traffic sources, visitor behavior and time spent.

![Meta Pixel integration](/images/integrations/icon_FACEBOOK_PIXEL.png)[Meta Pixel](/help/facebook-pixel-integration). Measure and optimize your ad campaigns.

![Zapier integration](/images/integrations/icon_ZAPIER.png)[Zapier](/help/zapier-integration). Send submissions to your favorite tools.

![Make integration](/images/integrations/icon_INTEGROMAT.png)[Make](/help/make-integration). Send submissions to your favorite tools.

![Pipedream integration](/images/integrations/icon_PIPEDREAM.png)[Pipedream](/help/pipedream-integration). Send submissions to your favorite tools.

And many more. Integrate with thousands of tools using Zapier, Make or Pipedream.

## Build stunning forms for free
It’s as simple as one-two-three, and guess what? You don’t even need an account to try it out!

Create a free form

![Particles](/images/demo/v2/particles-right.png)

“Absolutely adore Tally! A game-changer - incredibly powerful, yet ridiculously user-friendly. It enabled me to effortlessly gather inputs, add forms with ease, and even pre-fill them. And the icing on the cake - absolutely free to use!”

![Shyam Verma](/images/demo/v2/quote-shyam.png)

Shyam Verma

Digital creator

## Questions & answers
Is Tally really free?

Yes! Born out of frustration with expensive form builders, Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions for free within our [fair use guidelines](/help/fair-use-policy). You can [get started right away](/create) and create forms using advanced features like [conditional logic](/help/conditional-form-logic), [signatures](/help/electronic-signatures), [calculations](/help/form-calculator), [file uploads](/help/file-uploads), and many more — all for free and without time restrictions.

Are Tally forms secure?

Yes, Tally takes security seriously. As a Belgium-based (EU) company, we fully comply with [GDPR requirements](/help/gdpr) and store all form data in Europe. Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, and we provide you complete control over the information you collect. For enterprise needs, [Tally Business](/help/tally-business) allows you to [control submissions data retention](/help/submissions-data-retention).

How does Tally compare to other form builders?

Unlike most form builders that limit submissions or restrict advanced features to premium plans, Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions for free. Our intuitive interface and powerful features like conditional logic, signatures, and password protection are available without paywalls. For detailed comparisons with specific form builders like [Typeform](/help/tally-a-free-typeform-alternative), [Jotform](/help/tally-a-free-jotform-alternative), [Paperform](/help/tally-a-free-paperform-alternative), and others, take a look at out our [comparison guides](/help/compare).

How can I get started?

You can start creating your first form right away—no sign up needed! [Create your first form here](/create) or head over to our [signup page](/signup) to create your account. For tips and best practices, check out our [Get started guide](/help/create-a-form).

content:
# The story of Tally
Forms have been around since the beginning of the internet. And somehow, they’ve stayed complicated, expensive, and boring to build. We thought that didn’t make sense, so we built [Tally](https://tally.so): a form builder that doesn’t break the bank and feels as simple as writing a document.

From day one, we wanted Tally to feel different. Not just easier, but better. More fun to use. More flexible. Software you actually enjoy opening, not something you tolerate.

We believe tools should empower you and your work. Not limit you with features locked behind paywalls or constant nudges to upgrade. Good tools should be accessible, generous, and grow with you. That’s why Tally is free for most use cases, and stays affordable when you need more.

We’re a small, independent team based in Europe, bootstrapped and funded by our customers. That gives us the freedom to build the product the way we think it should be built. We care about the long term. About building something opinionated, focused, and something people genuinely love to use.

Tally is our take on what form building should feel like.

We hope you enjoy what we’re building.

— Team Tally

A: Google Forms and Tally both offer truly free plans with unlimited submissions. However, Tally provides significantly more advanced features on its free plan, including file uploads, conditional logic, payment processing, and [customization options](/help/customize-your-form) that Google Forms lacks.

**Q: Is Tally better than Typeform?**
A: For most users, yes. Tally offers unlimited forms and responses for free, while Typeform limits free users to 10 responses per month. Tally also includes many features (file uploads, payments, custom domains) that require expensive Typeform upgrades.

**Q: What's the cheapest form builder with unlimited responses?**
A: Tally offers unlimited responses [completely free](https://tally.so/pricing). If you need premium features, Tally Pro at $29/month is more affordable than Typeform ($39/mo for only 100 responses), Jotform ($34/mo for 1,000 responses), or Paperform ($20/mo with limits).

**Q: Can I switch form builders easily?**
A: You can [import your forms](/help/import) into Tally in one click.

**Q: Which form builder is best for small businesses?**
A: Tally is ideal for small businesses because it provides unlimited usage and professional features without subscription costs. As you grow, affordable upgrades add team collaboration and advanced customization without breaking the budget.

**Q: Are free form builders secure?**
A: Yes, reputable free form builders like Tally, Google Forms, and Typeform implement strong security measures. Tally is hosted in the EU, [GDPR-compliant](/help/gdpr), and offers features like password protection and two-factor authentication even on free plans.

**Q: What’s the best form builder to create professional forms?**
A: Tally is increasingly popular among developers, marketers, and product teams for its flexibility, customizability and value for money. Typeform remains popular for its specific format (one question per page). Jotform is common in enterprise settings with complex requirements, but not known for design flexibility.

**Q: Are Tally forms accessible?**
A: Yes. Tally forms are designed with accessibility in mind — built on semantic HTML, they can be completed using keyboard navigation and screen readers like VoiceOver and NVDA, on every plan, for free. Read more about [how Tally approaches accessibility](https://app.notion.com/p/37a8a570dd6a81aea931d5c282c43749).

# File upload forms
A file upload form lets you collect files directly from respondents, without the need for them to sign up. With Tally, you can add a file upload field to any form and start collecting images, PDFs, videos, audio files, and documents in minutes. You can allow multiple file uploads, define the file types and set size limits to match your needs. File upload forms are free on all Tally plans, with no limit on the number of files you can collect.

![Create a form with a file upload](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2F3afc7cd1-28d8-46a1-9953-efe0e1d4e19c%2FTally_File_Upload.jpg?table=block&id=d03102a0-a2af-4e8d-aafb-0b9153142005&cache=v2)

![File uploads are free for all Tally users. The free plan supports individual files up to 10 MB. Upgrade to Tally Pro to collect files of any size without limits.](https://app.notion.com/icons/gift_green.svg?mode=light)

File uploads are free for all Tally users. The free plan supports individual files up to 10 MB. Upgrade to [Tally Pro](https://tally.so/help/tally-pro) to collect files of any size without limits.

---

[Why use Tally for file upload forms?](#3368a570dd6a80ba929cf1e7ce6996b7)[How to add a build a file upload form (without login)](#3bcd712e81334fc8a8fd50d36a00e7ba)[File upload settings](#068ae965412343a2bfb9ff490b972e58)[Allow multiple file uploads](#642c932f2b7146019995d08bf6eca38c)[Set a maximum file size](#7d58edb054f547ee9f84854482cbaae1)[Restrict file types](#22f01d767a0146cbac61dfc73cb323f3)[Show or hide based on answers](#06d44474d058483b8ad169cc745271ff)[Accessing and downloading uploaded files](#3368a570dd6a80e898acda951b930de7)[Free file upload form templates](#d2ca6abcb35844ea94e156c0ea609427)[Frequently Asked Questions](#16ae3a3959fd4cbeb9ee38a6b7c1ad40)[Do more with Tally](#3b28a570dd6a80f98e73ec3c5b6e470f)

---

### **Why use Tally for file upload forms?**
- **No sign-in required**
  Unlike Google Forms and other tools, your respondents don’t need to log in to upload files. No Google account and login required.

- **Affordable file uploads**
  File uploads are often locked behind expensive plans in other tools. With Tally, you get file uploads up to 10MB per file for free, without paying enterprise-level prices just to collect files. [Tally Pro](/help/tally-pro) removes the 10MB file size limit per file at $29/month.

- **Your data is stored securely**
  Tally is based in Europe and complies with the [GDPR framework](/help/gdpr).

### How to add a build a file upload form (without login)
Type `/file` to insert a file upload block. Respondents can click to choose a file or directly drag files into the file upload block.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2Fd2987fff-6222-4c25-b75f-6951cc596d24%2FFile-upload-1.png?table=block&id=27358ba9-0018-49f1-8ad8-dcdadced8c4d&cache=v2)

### File upload settings
Click `::` to open the file upload settings. You can:

- Make the file upload required or optional

- Allow multiple files (and set a minimum and maximum number of files)

- Set a maximum file size

- Define the allowed file types

- Hide a block (and show it with [conditional logic](/help/conditional-form-logic))

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2Fa75aa45c-3e74-4904-86ca-eb54adb2675f%2FFile-upload-2.png?table=block&id=13ea1b98-a12e-4da3-ad4b-69bf20f1e0f9&cache=v2)

#### Allow multiple file uploads
If you want respondents to be able to upload multiple files, enable the `Multiple files`option. This will allow you to define the desired `minimum`and `maximum`number of file uploads.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2F32f7b0d2-9e7e-4b51-8e4f-50bb3274dfe9%2FFile-upload-3.png?table=block&id=ae211290-967c-48d1-884e-ef09a2a99f60&cache=v2)

Respondents can drag multiple files at once in the file upload block or upload them one by one, using the `Upload another file` button.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2F5827ef3c-1622-4856-8c16-c475b07dde2b%2FFile-upload-4.png?table=block&id=cac2a5c0-ab98-42ce-a4d3-6c05161e8865&cache=v2)

#### Set a maximum file size
Enable `Max file size` to set a file size limit. Respondents will see the maximum file size limit in the file upload block.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2Ffce71b96-fd50-4c16-95e7-90de460ed669%2FFile-upload-5.png?table=block&id=d8a3853e-c0c2-411f-96cb-104a9a338ceb&cache=v2)

![Tally allows file uploads with an individual size of 10MB for free. To collect larger files, upgrade to Tally Pro.](https://app.notion.com/icons/flash_pink.svg?mode=light)

Tally allows file uploads with an individual size of **10MB for free**. To collect larger files, upgrade to [Tally Pro](/help/tally-pro).

#### Restrict file types
To only accept certain file types, enable `Allowed files` and select the file type(s) you want to accept. For example:

- If you only want to accept image files, regardless of the type, select `All image files`

- If you only want to accept .jpg files, select `.jpg`

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2F564a6e4e-2959-4388-9afa-674bd6f70e7f%2FFile-upload-6.png?table=block&id=42f45c69-f489-4450-9916-18842321d296&cache=v2)

Respondents will see the required file type(s) indicated in the file upload block.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2F69cd9fac-5736-4d07-8bfc-f21938db93d2%2FFile-upload-7.png?table=block&id=e8798d6e-ddff-4904-9b9e-51e32232e50d&cache=v2)

#### Show or hide based on answers
You can use [conditional logic](https://www.notion.so/6ea9699f446740c8937058ef0dc4dea1) to show or hide the file upload block depending on a respondent's previous answers. For example, only ask for a portfolio if someone selects "Freelancer" as their role, or only request a doctor's note if a respondent confirms a medical absence.

### Accessing and downloading uploaded files
All uploaded files are stored securely and accessible from the `Submissions` tab of your form. They can be accessed through an authenticated link or downloaded directly to your device.

- **View files:** Open any submission to preview or access uploaded files. You need to be logged in to your Tally account to view them.

![notion image](https://app.notion.com/image/https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fc7def46e-5b1b-431a-b65a-93222e53bf0d%2Fad32bc82-d1d9-4f9c-b12d-2789c73de35d%2FAuthenticated_file_upload_URLS.png?table=block&id=673a18a5-6d9c-43f4-b50a-ed234ee04c54&cache=v2)

- **Download individual files:** Click the download icon next to any file within a submission.

- **Batch download:** Use the 'Download file uploads' button at the top of the submissions page to download all files at once. If your form submissions span multiple pages, you'll need to repeat this step on each page to download all files.

### Frequently Asked Questions
**Can I create a file upload form without login?**

Yes. Unlike with Google Forms, respondents can upload files without signing up for Tally or creating any kind of account.

**What is the maximum file size I can upload with a free Tally account?**

With a free account, the maximum file size you can upload is 10MB. However, if you have a [Pro account](/help/tally-pro), there's no limit to the file upload size.

**How many files can I upload? Is there a limit to the total weight of the files?**

No, there's no limit to the number of files you can upload or the total storage. However, please note that you must respect our [Fair Use Policy](/help/fair-use-policy).

**Is there a time limit for how long my files are stored in the system?**

No, there's no time limit. As long as your account is open and the responses are not deleted from your account, the files are preserved.

**Do I need to respect any usage guidelines?**

Yes, as a user of our service, you must respect our [Fair Use Policy.](/help/fair-use-policy) This policy helps us maintain the quality and integrity of our service for all users.
